\[
S_r=\sum_{k\equiv r\pmod{502}}\binom{10000}{k}

\qquad \omega=e^{2\pi i/502}.
\]

Work modulo the prime \(p=503\).  
Since \(10000=503\cdot19+443\),

\[
(1+x)^{10000}\equiv(1+x^{503})^{19}(1+x)^{443}\pmod{503}.
\]

Because \((1+x^{503})^{19}=\sum_{s=0}^{19}\binom{19}{s}x^{503s}\) and
\((1+x)^{443}=\sum_{t=0}^{443}\binom{443}{t}x^{t}\), the coefficient of
\(x^{k}\) in the reduction is  

\[
\binom{19}{s}\binom{443}{t}\quad\text{if }k=503s+t,\;0\le s\le19,\;0\le t\le443.
\]

Hence, modulo \(503\),

\[
S_r\equiv\sum_{\substack{0\le s\le19\\0\le t\le443\\503s+t\equiv r\;(\bmod 502)}}
\binom{19}{s}\binom{443}{t}.
\]

Because \(503\equiv1\pmod{502}\), the congruence becomes \(s+t\equiv r\pmod{502}\).
Since \(s\le19\) and \(t\le443\), we have \(s+t\le462<502\); thus the
condition reduces to \(s+t=r\) when \(0\le r\le462\), and there is no
solution when \(r>462\).

Therefore  

\[
S_r\equiv\sum_{s=0}^{19}\binom{19}{s}\binom{443}{\,r-s\,}
      =\binom{462}{r}\qquad(0\le r\le462),
\]
and \(S_r\equiv0\) for \(463\le r\le501\).

Now \(503\) is a prime larger than \(462\).  For any \(0\le r\le462\)
the binomial coefficient \(\binom{462}{r}\) is not divisible by \(503\),
because the numerator and denominator are products of integers all
\(<503\).  Consequently \(S_r\not\equiv0\pmod{503}\) for \(0\le r\le462\).

For the remaining residues \(r=463,464,\dots,501\) we have \(S_r\equiv0\pmod{503}\),
so these are multiples of \(503\).

The number of such residues is  

\[
501-463+1 = 39.
\]

\[
\boxed{39}
\]
